source_documents.title: Quantitative Design of Bright Fluorophores and AIEgens via the Accurate Prediction of Twisted Intramolecular Charge Transfer (TICT)

reference_evidence_units.quote: the rotation of θ towards 90° is almost barrierless in AZE-Ph-BDP.
reference_evidence_units.subject: AZE-Ph-BDP
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source predicts almost barrierless meso-phenyl/BODIPY twisting toward a TICT geometry.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is the authors' calculation, not a new simulation; it does not identify azetidine twisting as the favorable rotor.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the further rotation of the azetidine group is energetically unfavorable on the S1 and S2 PESs.
reference_evidence_units.subject: AZE-Ph-BDP
reference_evidence_units.conditions: THF energy scans of both candidate rotation coordinates.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Azetidine remains aligned with the phenyl group; its further rotation is unfavorable.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Coordinate assignment is model-dependent; Figure 6b-c visually inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: resulting in a negligible oscillator strength (f = 0.00; Figure 6c).
reference_evidence_units.subject: AZE-Ph-BDP
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Computed lowest singlet perpendicular conformation in THF.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The fully separated TICT configuration is calculated to be dark.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Calculated oscillator strength is not an experimentally determined radiative rate; S2 in the scan is not evidence of S2 emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: AZE-Ph-BDP is emissive only in hexane (Φ = 0.36; Figure 6d).
reference_evidence_units.subject: AZE-Ph-BDP
reference_evidence_units.statement: Hexane quantum yield is 0.36; tested polar solvents have negligible yield.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Only the tested solvent set is covered, not all possible environments.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the fluorescence of AZE-Ph-BDP greatly intensifies in highly viscous solvents.
reference_evidence_units.subject: AZE-Ph-BDP
reference_evidence_units.statement: Increasing the glycerol-rich viscous fraction strongly enhances fluorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Viscosity and solvent composition co-vary; this is not an isolated torsion-rate measurement.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The molecular aggregates effectively inhibit TICT rotations.
reference_evidence_units.subject: AZE-Ph-BDP
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign aggregation turn-on to restriction of TICT rotations.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A bounded source interpretation supported by solvent, viscosity and calculation comparisons, not definitive exclusion of other mechanisms.

reference_evidence_units.quote: we observed a great enhancement of emission intensities, up to ~27 times.
reference_evidence_units.subject: AZE-Ph-BDP
reference_evidence_units.statement: Aggregation produces reported fluorescence enhancement up to about 27-fold.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The fold change is relative intensity, not a quantum yield; aggregate molecular packing is not resolved.

reference_evidence_units.quote: shows bright fluorescence in the solid state (Φ = 0.11; Figure S49).
reference_evidence_units.subject: AZE-Ph-BDP
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Solid-state result reported in main text with SI reference.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Solid quantum yield is reported as 0.11.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Figure S49 itself was not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the highly emissive LE state of Ph-BDP remains the most stable singlet excited state on a flat PES
reference_evidence_units.subject: Ph-BDP
reference_evidence_units.statement: Parent Ph-BDP provides the bright LE comparator for the designed dark TICT monomer.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not transfer the parent's emissive state or quantum yield to AZE-Ph-BDP.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Restriction of the identified TICT twisting coordinate describes the same pathway at the motion level.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Aggregate environment is proposed to constrain TICT rotations; no particular crystal packing motif is assigned.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The source's central explanation is dark TICT formation in polar monomers and inhibition in aggregates; the favorable rotor is meso-phenyl/BODIPY, not the azetidine bond.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Calculated dark TICT versus emissive LE/less-twisted states supplies a state-brightness interpretation, overlapping rather than independent of TICT.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Restriction of the identified TICT twisting coordinate describes the same pathway at the motion level.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Aggregate environment is proposed to constrain TICT rotations; no particular crystal packing motif is assigned.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No guest-binding or inclusion mechanism linked to target emission established; solvent polarity alone does not establish host-guest binding.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The source's central explanation is dark TICT formation in polar monomers and inhibition in aggregates; the favorable rotor is meso-phenyl/BODIPY, not the azetidine bond.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer mechanism established; hydrogen bonding or ground-state acid-base chemistry alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No separate photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on established; intramolecular CT is not automatically PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Aggregation alone does not establish excitonic coupling, H/J aggregation, excimer or exciplex emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Calculated dark TICT versus emissive LE/less-twisted states supplies a state-brightness interpretation, overlapping rather than independent of TICT.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet, metal-centered or energy-transfer emissive mechanism established in the selected conditions.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection-mediated nonradiative pathway established; twisting alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No emission from higher excited states or suppression of Kasha's rule established.
